summary.text: Russ Hodgkins is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election. He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Russ Hodgkins was born in Quincy, Massachusetts, and graduated from Quincy High School, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the U.S. Air Force Academy in 1980 and served in the U.S. Air Force from 1976 to 2009.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as a pilot and his affiliations as including Eastern Slopes Aviation Academy, the U.S. Air Force Academy Association of Graduates and the Civil Air Patrol.
Hodgkins was a Republican candidate for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 34 in the November 5, 2024 general election, in which three Democratic incumbents won the district's seats.
